Subject: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Coupa)

Hi Diego,

We received the invite to join Redwood's supplier portal (Coupa) but when I click the accept link I get to a login page that rejects our password and then shows an error: "Authentication failed: unknown provider." Tried twice in Chrome and Edge — same result. Screenshot attached.

We need to get set up so PO routing can start this week. Can you resend or provide a workaround?

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of AP Operations
Pinwheel Logistics

Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Coupa)

Hi Liam — sorry about the friction.

Quick context: Redwood's Coupa tenant uses SSO mapping for some orgs and a fallback local account flow for others. Pinwheel looks like it's being routed to SSO, but your org doesn't have the IdP assertion configured on our side yet, so the SSO handoff fails.

Immediate options:
- I can reissue a "local" invite that forces a standard email/password flow (temporary password) — that'll get you in while we sort the IdP mapping.
- Alternatively, you can try an incognito window and clear cookies (sometimes old cookies from previous Coupa sessions trap the request).

I'll attach the raw headers from the original invite so our ops team can inspect routing. Rafael — can you take a look at the invite headers and confirm whether the relaystate is pointing at the wrong tenant?

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Supplier Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Coupa)

Hi team — quick update and resolution steps below.

Summary of root cause: the original invite included a relayState token that referenced a deprecated tenant alias (we recently cleaned up old aliases during a tenant consolidation). That alias resolves to a dead IdP mapping which causes Coupa to attempt SSO against a non-existent provider and immediately fail with the "unknown provider" message you saw.

Remediation performed:
- Recreated and sent a new invite that forces the local account path (will show "Create password" rather than SSO). Link sent to Liam directly at 2027-03-05T15:45:12-07:00.
- Invalidated the old invite token and added a validation to our invite generator to avoid deprecated alias insertion.

Liam — action for you: open the new link in a fresh browser (incognito recommended), create a password, then upload W-9 and bank details. If anything still fails send the screenshot and we'll escalate immediately.

Ben — FYI on the validation change; could you review the generator patch in PR #784 and sign off?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Platform Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference
